cell_1: Model 26.0 stock-status summary. The 2025--2026 columns report status for 2025 and 2026; historical determinations are from the 2024 assessment.
Historical determinations are from the December 2024 EBS pollock SAFE, Executive Summary, p. 4.

Assessment conclusions are separate from final NMFS determinations. Updated 2025 catch (1,326,215.61 t) is below its 2,957,000-t OFL. For Model 26.0, 2026 spawning biomass (3.057 million t) and Alternative 7 biomass in 2028 (3.123 million t) both exceed B35% (2.155 million t), supporting the two 2026 "No" entries. [Section 9](#sec-status-determination) describes the status tests. Each two-year column pair reports overfishing for the earlier catch year and stock status for the later assessment year; cells outside those year-specific determinations are marked n/a. NMFS issues the final status determinations.
